title: Wastewater sequencing enables scalable measles surveillance - Nature Medicine
html:
Integrated clinical and wastewater monitoring during the 2024–2025 outbreaks of measles in South Africa enabled high-resolution tracking of virus spread and evolution. Whole-genome amplicon sequencing of wastewater samples revealed shifts in genotype prevalence, detailed transmission links and previously unreported interprovincial spread.

This preprint study introduces Freyja 2, our updated bioinformatics tool that analyzes wastewater and complex environmental samples to track pathogen evolution and spread.
